ema_strategy._lengths_note: EMA lengths are always 8/13/21/55 but measured in BARS at the active chart interval (SIGNAL_INTERVAL): 55 bars = 55 hours on a 1h chart, 55 days on a 1d chart, 55 weeks on a 1w chart. Lengths never change; only the bar interval does.
ema_strategy.buy_signal: 55EMA crosses below ALL of 8/13/21 EMA — becomes lowest line
ema_strategy.sell_signal: 55EMA crosses above ALL of 8/13/21 EMA — becomes highest line
ema_strategy.hold_rule: when 55EMA above all 3 — do nothing, stock is downtrending
